prompt.project_info: Casual low-light smartphone selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Two clearly adult original women seated together at a luxurious restaurant table during a night out. The woman holding the phone wears an elegant red evening dress and warm glamorous makeup; the second wears a deep-blue evening dress with a flattering neckline, laughs naturally and holds a glass of red wine.
prompt.composition_elements: Handheld selfie with slightly extended arm, casual cropped framing and candid mid-laughter expressions. Wine glasses, candlelight and softly blurred luxury tableware occupy the table; dim upscale nightlife setting behind them.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft ambient golden night lighting reflecting on faces, shallow depth of field, mild motion softness and authentic unposed social-night-out energy.
prompt.technical_specs: Handheld smartphone look, low light, slight blur, mild digital noise, imperfect focus, uneven natural exposure and subtle motion softness; avoid polished studio finish.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Casual low-light smartphone selfie of two clearly adult original women on a night out at a luxurious restaurant table, one holding the phone in an elegant red evening dress and the other laughing in a deep-blue evening dress while holding red wine, candlelight, wine glasses, blurred luxury tableware, warm golden ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, slight motion softness, mild noise and authentic candid social-night-out atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, studio lighting, professional photography, ultra-sharp focus, HDR, cinematic over-processing, plastic skin, posed expressions, flash photography, AI artifacts, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, watermark
